text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Just a little longer now... Hehe, waiting for
the curtain to rise is so
exciting, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Earlier that day...

Thank you for seeing me off. I'll be sure to
call you when I'm on my
way home.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer, good day to you. I didn't
expect to see you here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm headed to the theater. One of our
family's sponsors sent us a
couple of
tickets for a play.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My sister was supposed to join me, but she
unfortunately has a race
today, so I'm
going alon—ah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I understand that this is very sudden, but
would you like to join me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad we could see this play
together, Trainer. It's a very
popular
piece—one that I've been meaning to see
for some time now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It's the story of two knights who decide to
seek fame and fortune by
expelling a
ghost from a haunted castle. It's a comedy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I've heard it's based on a classic, but
according to reviews, it has its
own merits
as a piece of contemporary—oh, it's
starting.

text_block_list.name: Knight A
text_block_list.text:
My friend, do my eyes deceive me? Is that
not the accursed castle,
said to only
appear at dusk? What a foreboding
atmosphere...

text_block_list.name: Knight B
text_block_list.text:
Do not let the tales of ghosts and ghouls
frighten you, comrade! O
Lady Luck, grant
us your boon on this hunt, so that we may
at last
obtain glory!

text_block_list.name: Knights
text_block_list.text:
A g-g-g-g-ghost?! Oh, it was just you...
Hey, quit copying me! Arrrghh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh dear! Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
True to the play's reputation, the theater
periodically fills with
laughter. But the
most memorable part of the play for me is
watching
Ardan's reactions.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It seems the reviews were spot-on. It
certainly was entertaining to
watch those
two jump at every single sound, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However... I am a little sad a ghost never
actually appeared. If it were
me, I would
return to that castle every night until I
finally saw one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't teatime with a ghost sound
delightful? I'm sure they'd have
plenty of
stories about the castle's history...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And... Allowing someone forgotten to
shine again for just a moment
feels like a
resurrection of sorts, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Sigh... What a pleasant breeze.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, would you like to take a walk with
me? The sunset is so
beautiful, after all. It
almost feels like—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... wouldn't that be a splendid
surprise.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As a child, I would often imagine myself as
one of the characters in
the play I had just
seen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I could be anything—a young man or even
an old woman. Sometimes
I'd go on an
adventure, while other times I'd do
something bad and
get scolded for it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
We only live once, but through the power
of imagination, I felt like I
was able to step
into the life of another for a brief moment.
It was like
a secret game.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm not so sure about that. Perhaps I'm a
curious ghost, simply
observing the two
bumbling intruders who claim to be there
to hunt
me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Good point... If the knights had actually
found the ghost, would it
have wanted to
talk to them?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If it were me, I'd certainly want to know
what sort of people the
knights were.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: For example, what sort of games did they play as children?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear! Hehe, you must have been quite
the adorable child, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to hear more. Tell me, what else
did you play as a child?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
P-pardon me. Goodness... My stomach
doesn't usually growl like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh really? I hadn't noticed. Your stories
were just so interesting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
We certainly have walked a lot though... I
usually avoid taking such
long walks.
Otherwise people worry about my health.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In addition, I was wondering... Perhaps we
could use today's
increased practice
regimen going forward?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I was just about to ask.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Ehehe, I should be grateful. As I
am now, I don't have to worry
about
overheating anymore.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(That's right. Trainer always believes in my
abilities...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(How strange... My chest feels so warm...
Trainer is so...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, I'm fine. I was just reflecting on
how much fun I've had
today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, please stop teasing me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
But yes... Today certainly was filled with
excitement. I believe I
learned something
new about myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that... is a secret.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In any case, the sun will soon set. We
should both head home before
we run into
an actual ghost.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you again for accepting my sudden
invitation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While she doesn't give in to my teasing, I
notice that I feel closer to
Mejiro Ardan
now than at the beginning of the day.
